title: Oven-Roasted French Shungiku Pot-au-Feu
description: A spicy, low-calorie French dish from Brittany, perfect for a romantic dinner featuring shungiku and potatoes in a rich vegetable broth.
instructions: Chop the shungiku, potatoes, carrots, and onions into bite-sized pieces.
Mince the garlic and chop the bay leaves and thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the garlic, bay leaves, and thyme to the pot and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the shungiku, potatoes, carrots, onions, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Pour in the lemon juice and stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 45 minutes, then remove the pot from the oven and carefully remove the bay leaves and thyme.
Serve the pot-au-feu hot, garnished with lemon wedges and chopped fresh herbs.
Strain the cooking liquid and serve it on the side as a broth.
Garnish with a sprinkle of chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
